name: Rogue River (Grants Pass)
blurb: Hellgate Canyon day floats below Grants Pass — the easy half of the Rogue, with jet boats for company.

sections.notes: Floats through Hellgate Canyon. Watch for jet boats and give them room in narrow spots.

putInAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency launch record and satellite imagery agree on this riverside access facility. The marker is an approximate facility location, not a surveyed landing edge.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Hog Creek. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

sections.notes: A day float below Galice ending at Grave Creek. Arrange a road shuttle first and check current road/launch conditions. Stop at Grave Creek; continuing downstream enters the remote Wild Rogue permit section.

notices.title: Stop before the Wild Rogue
notices.text: Grave Creek is the end of this day trip. Downstream trips enter the wilderness river corridor and require separate planning and applicable permits.
